[[The Ruptured Heart]] | henchman = y | merchant = y | skill trainer = y | storage = y | pic1 = [[Image:The Mouth of Torment world map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = On the world map | pic2 = [[Image:The Mouth of Torment inside.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view inside }} {{Quotation|game|It was here that [[Abaddon]] and his [[Margonite]]s challenged the power of the [[Gods of Tyria|Five True Gods]], and here that the other gods smote the [[Abaddon|God of Secrets]] down, imprisoning him and his following in a [[Realm of Torment]]. This once beautiful land is now a crater littered with the trappings of a god. And above it the Mouth of Torment hangs, a weakness in the world, a globe of pure evil, beckoning all to their doom.}} [[The Mouth of Torment]] is the site of a terrible rift that connects the [[Realm of Torment]] to [[Elona]]. One can travel to that dark and dangerous realm by stepping into the [[Vortex]] that was opened by [[Warmarshal]] [[Varesh Ossa]]'s death. ==Getting there== This outpost becomes accessible after completion of the [[Ruins of Morah]] [[mission]]. The mission will not automatically bring the party here though; it will bring them to the [[Gate of Torment]]. From there, step into the [[Vortex]] to arrive here ([[map travel]] via the Vortex in the [[Realm of Torment]] works too). ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 20 [[Kenmu]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 20 [[Dau]] ([[skill trainer]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) =====Henchmen===== :''(all level 20)'' *{{w}} [[Devona]] (Fighter) *{{r}} [[Aidan]] (Archer) *{{mo}} [[Kihm]] (Healer) *{{mo}} [[Mhenlo]] (Healer) *{{n}} [[Eve]] (Blood) *{{me}} [[Odurra]] (Illusion) *{{e}} [[Cynn]] (Fire) *{{e}} [[Herta]] (Earth) *{{p}} [[Sogolon]] (Motivation) *{{d}} [[Gehraz]] (Holy) ====Other allies==== *{{x}} 20 [[Ascension Pilgrim]] *{{x}} 20 [[Dynastic Spirit]] ==Notes== {{gw2w|The Mouth of Torment}} *This outpost will actually appear on your [[world map]] after completion of the [[Ruins of Morah]] mission, without you needing to first unlock it by an initial visit. *If someone in your party hasn't completed the Ruins of Morah mission (such as when taking the Crystal Overlook Teleporter from [[The Arid Sea]]) then the outpost will be locked for everyone. *If your character approaches the central vortex (above the large hole in the ground), they will be affected by the [[Approaching the Vortex]] [[environment effect|effect]]. *This outpost counts toward the Elona [[Cartographer]] title, but provides less than 0.1% to it. *The Mouth of Torment, [[Tihark Orchard (outpost)|Tihark Orchard]], [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh (outpost)|Grand Court of Sebelkeh]], [[Yahnur Market]], [[Brauer Academy]], [[Piken Square (pre-Searing)]], [[Sifhalla]], and [[Tarnished Haven]] are the only outposts with two exits leading to the same zone. {{Towns and outposts in the Desolation}}
